title: Prime Minister shares an article by Union Minister of State highlighting teaching as a creative act and recognizing teachers as contributors to nation-building
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by Union Minister of State, Shri Jayant Chaudhary.
The Prime Minister noted that the Union Minister of State writes that teaching is an art and a creative act, requiring human connections, pedagogy and the ability to see potential in students. He added that the article highlights how NEP 2020, ULLAS, Vidyanjali and various other initiatives are strengthening teaching and learning, while recognising every teacher as a contributor to nation-building.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“Union MoS Shri @jayantrld writes that teaching is an art and a creative act, requiring human connections, pedagogy and the ability to see potential in students.
He highlights how NEP 2020, ULLAS, Vidyanjali and various other initiatives are strengthening teaching and learning, while recognising every teacher as a contributor to nation-building.”
